# Millefeuille Live Golden Run Fixture

Public-safe aggregate evidence from the first approved live Millefeuille run.

The fixture records stage counts, route choice, model provenance, classification
outcome, and pending Zotero writeback intent. It intentionally omits Zotero
item keys, attachment keys, library IDs, private filesystem paths, PDF bytes,
provider payloads, OCR text, OpenKB raw Markdown, signed URLs, and credentials.
